frame_68.jpg.note: Tiny stiff figures in rigid rows on a flat sandy deck, set against clean blocky walls and cannon stacks. It reads as a tabletop diorama, and the figures are too small to show any craft.

frame_62.jpg.note: Dense red blocks of near-identical specks with no individual variation, on low-poly flat terrain with blocky buildings. They read as game-unit swarms or tabletop pieces.

frame_46.jpg.note: Detailed, weathered walls make the smooth, plasticky, doll-like figures look pasted in. They have stiff rod-like limbs, flat uniform colour, mannequin poses, clumped overlapping bodies, weak contact shadows and no cloth sim or fabric detail.

frame_95.jpg.note: Same mismatch as frame_46: the cobbles and plaster are photoreal while the people look like plastic toy soldiers. Uniform smooth sculpts, stiff upright poses, grouped like game pieces and sitting weightless on the ground.

frame_30.jpg.note: More believable street scale and spacing, and the mixed sailor and army uniforms add variety. Still waxy, simplified mannequin bodies with stiff poses, weak grounding and no fabric response to the light.

frame_25.jpg.note: Identical to the frame_62 view: massed identical specks in blocky formations on a flat, low-poly sandy plain. They read as game pieces or miniatures.
